card.name: CivicBridge English-Hindi demonstration corpus
card.description: Hand-authored fictional civic reports for demonstrating a training pipeline. Not collected from citizens; not a production benchmark.
card.algorithm: Multinomial Naive Bayes · Unicode words and bigrams · Laplace smoothing
card.limitations: Synthetic demonstration data. Held-out examples are distinct but share the authored demo domain. These metrics do not establish performance on real citizen reports. Scores are uncalibrated. Human review is required.
